cards.name: Shower of Coals
cards.oracleText:
Shower of Coals deals 2 damage to each of up to three targets.
Threshold — Shower of Coals deals 4 damage to each of those permanents and/or players instead if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.

cards.name: Shower of Sparks
cards.oracleText: Shower of Sparks deals 1 damage to target creature and 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.

cards.name: Shower of Arrows
cards.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying. Scry 1.

cards.name: Showdown of the Skalds
cards.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Exile the top four cards of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play those cards.
II, III — Whenever you cast a spell this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

cards.name: Show of Valor
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+4 until end of turn.

cards.name: Show of Confidence
cards.oracleText:
When you cast this spell, copy it for each other instant and sorcery spell you've cast this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.
Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains vigilance until end of turn.

cards.name: Showstopper
cards.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control gain "When this creature dies, it deals 2 damage to target creature an opponent controls."

cards.name: Show and Tell
cards.oracleText: Each player may put an artifact, creature, enchantment, or land card from their hand onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Showstopping Surprise
cards.oracleText: Choose target creature you control. Turn it face up if it's face down. Then it deals damage equal to its power to each other creature.
